notes: Roche publishes employees by region only (Annual Report 2024 chart; FTEs at Dec 31, 2024, total 103,249). The regions are Roche's own groupings with no country list, except Australia/New Zealand. No country or U.S. state breakdown of employees, sites or taxes was found in the Annual Report or the Finance Report 2024 (the Finance Report gives only group income taxes paid, CHF 3,727 million). Roche does not file with the SEC. The Annual Report PDF is served from Roche's asset CDN (assets.roche.com), linked from roche.com/investors/annualreport24. Sites are those the report itself names; Roche does not list its major facilities in the Annual Report.
